curated.name: Hello Em

curated.name: Cardoon

curated.name: Analog Coffee

curated.name: SUKOSHI

curated.name: KOBO Capitol Hill
curated.note: the original shop/gallery, Japanese-aesthetic gifts and art.

curated.name: Storica Studio

curated.name: Valerie Madison
curated.note: Seattle-made fine jewelry, ethically sourced stones.

curated.name: America's Car Museum

curated.name: LeMay Collections at Marymount
curated.note: huge family car collection in a former military academy, with guided tours year-round.

curated.name: Seattle Glassblowing Studio & Gallery
curated.note: book-ahead "blow your own" session (ornament, paperweight, bowl etc.); pieces cool for 24-48 hrs, so do it Fri/Sat to pick up before leaving Mon. Groupon deals are common.

curated.name: Glassybaby hot shop
curated.note: hands-on glassblowing sessions, including a winter ornament session in past years (~$180, 12+). Check the 2026 dates.

curated.name: Seattle Artist League
curated.note: one-night "One Shot Pot" beginner wheel class (~$95 incl. materials) and other drop-in art classes; check the calendar for December dates.

curated.name: Seattle Kraken (NHL)
curated.note: *home Sun 12/6 at 5 PM vs Buffalo Sabres*, which fits the free Sunday. Other home games are Dec 1, Dec 3 (Dallas) and Dec 10 (Washington).

curated.name: Seattle Seahawks (NFL)
curated.note: *home Mon 12/7 at 5:15 PM vs Dallas Cowboys* (Monday night). Expensive, but rare. It also means heavy SoDo and light rail traffic Monday evening. Other home games: Dec 13 Giants and Dec 25 Rams.

curated.name: Seattle Thunderbirds (WHL junior hockey)
curated.note: cheap, loud and close. Resale sites list *Sun 12/6 at 4:05 PM vs Victoria Royals*; confirm on the team site.
